scenario: StatefulSet rolling update stuck — PVC bound to old pod prevents rescheduling
query: kafka-2 never comes back after the rolling update in the data namespace
notes: StatefulSet kafka rolls pod kafka-2. Its claim data-kafka-2 is Bound to a local volume pinned to worker-node-01, and worker-node-01 is cordoned for a drain: the scheduler reports a volume node affinity conflict on the free node and the two other nodes unschedulable, so kafka-2 stays Pending. Fix: uncordon worker-node-01 for the rollout, or move the data and recreate the claim. Corrected 2026-10-20 (docs/failing-cases-002.md S6): the claim was absent from the fixture (read as missing) and two event messages were invented.
